'''Rokure''' was an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] loyal to [[Darth Krayt]] and the [[One Sith|Sith]]. The captain served under [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] and commanded the [[Relentless (Sith Imperial ship)|''Relentless'']], a vessel that took Lord Krayt and his closest and most powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] to [[Had Abbadon]], where they would be [[Battle on Had Abbadon|ambushed]] by a strikeforce of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Imperial Knight]]s.<ref name="Legacy 31" />
